mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be fresh watermelon, a fruit with high water content and a moderate glycemic effect due to its natural sugars. For someone with diabetes, portion size still matters for blood sugar levels, and pairing fruit with a high-fiber or protein-containing food may help moderate the response. It is best to avoid or strictly limit large portions of this meal, opting for a high-fiber fruit such as berries instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Three pieces of fresh watermelon served plain.
